current_task_corrections.correction: Add 'synthetic_caveats' to the brief_sections.sections parameter. Change from [key_findings, model_results, limitations, next_steps] to [key_findings, model_results, limitations, synthetic_caveats, next_steps].
Change brief_sections.causal_language parameter from 'allow' to 'avoid'. Synthetic data descriptive analysis cannot support causal claims.
Setting causal_language to 'avoid' prevents generation of causal phrasing. Re-execute with this setting to eliminate forbidden phrases such as 'drives'.

reusable_lessons.lesson: Executive briefs about synthetic or observational data must include an explicit synthetic_caveats section to transparently document data limitations and protect stakeholder interpretation.

Always set causal_language to 'avoid' for descriptive analysis of synthetic data. This parameter setting is foundational; it both prevents causal phrasing generation and reinforces statistical discipline, making post-hoc editing unnecessary.
